items.text: Sabaraha kali ogé kuring nyarita, ulah diteunggeul budak, manéhna nyarita, kuring shell-shock waktu perang, teu kuat ditahan.
items.q: He blames his violence on war trauma. Is 'shell-shock' clear to Sundanese readers?

items.text: Waktu manéhna nyarita geus ngadéngé stan Mazandaran poé ieu méré kolang-kaling hejo jeung sayuran nu teu apal ngaranna, kuring nempo diri kuring leumpang gigireun Farid turun tangga paméran Kota Kuring-Budaya Kuring.
items.q: A fair stall hands out sour green plums. Is 'kolang-kaling' the right word?

items.text: Manéhna teu datang. Kuring ngarasa deudeuh jajantung, aya nu meupeuskeun beuheung kuring.
items.q: Niloofar has not come. Is it clear Amir feels a choking in his throat?

items.text: – Manéhna maksa ulah dihudangkeun. Manéh mah teu kungsi ngomong, naha manéh moal paéh lamun kamari gé teu muka sungut?
items.q: Is it clear the speaker means: you should have kept quiet yesterday too?

items.text: Manéhna budak lalaki leutik, buukna panjang jeung meber, panonna gedé, kulitna hideung kaboseun, sarta sirahna leutik pisan nu upama teu aya buuk meberna gé bakal katempo leutik dina awakna nu leutik.
items.q: Is it clear his head would look tiny if he had no hair?

items.text: – Sagala kalakuan manéhna téh matak maéhan batur, éta jelema.
items.q: Is it clear everything Farid did was self-destructive?

items.text: – Mun maneh hayang mawa mobil-mobilan éta, sok atuh.
items.q: Taghi agrees to the fight, on one condition. Is that clear?

items.text: Budak Bapa ngadorong roda kai jambon leutikna jeung viizj-viizj ngajauhan.
items.q: Is 'roda kai' the right word for a child's kick scooter?
